# This is a script test conversion of TestListTemplateContextFunction
# originally added in CL 20010, which fixed #14547.
# Test the ability to use the build context in the bolero list template.

bolero list -f '{{context.GOARCH}} {{context.GOOS}} {{context.GOROOT}} {{context.GOPATH}}'
cmpenv stdout want.txt

bolero list -f '{{context.CgoEnabled}} {{context.UseAllFiles}} {{context.Compiler}} {{context.BuildTags}} {{context.ReleaseTags}} {{context.InstallSuffix}}'

-- go.mod --
module foo
-- foo.go --
package foo
-- want.txt --
$GOARCH $GOOS $BOLERO_ROOT $BOLERO_PATH
